name: Microsoft Entra client secret
renew: Make a new secret in the Microsoft Entra admin center: App registrations > Relay Mail > Certificates & secrets. Put it in MICROSOFT_CLIENT_SECRET in Vercel (production) and in .env, then redeploy. Then change the date in .github/secret-expiry.json.

name: Cloudflare API token for GitHub Actions
renew: Make a new account token in the Cloudflare dashboard (Manage account > Account API tokens) with Workers Scripts Write, Workers Observability Write, Account Settings Read, and Account Analytics Read. Put it in the CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN secret of this repository, delete the old token, then change the date in .github/secret-expiry.json.
